Title: IKEA Store & Organise Report 2026: Finding Meaning in the Mess
Evidence Used: Survey of 31,488 people in 31 markets: 68% report a catch-all drawer or box; 11% of Gen Z spend over 30 minutes daily looking for a charger; kitchen counters lead clutter and conflict; 82% keep sentimental objects.
Used For: Directional problem evidence for exact-fit drawers; cables; counters; sentimental storage and small-space organization.

Title: How to Spot Trends and Keywords With Marketplace Insights
Evidence Used: Etsy states that Marketplace Insights exposes real Etsy search volume; recent trends and listing competition; it recommends niche and keyword validation rather than treating broad trends as proof.
Used For: Required next-step demand and competition check for every research idea before selection.

Title: Michaels 2026 Creativity Trend Report
Evidence Used: Company search; sales and survey data report analog-hobby searches up 136%; yarn-accessory sales up 40%; needlepoint searches up 251%; sewing-pattern searches up 152%; craft-night searches up 103%; guided-kit sales up 86%.
Used For: Directional evidence for adult craft; sewing; journaling; group-craft and tool-organization concepts.

Title: 2025 Recommerce Report
Evidence Used: eBay reports passion as a major seller motive in trading cards; collectibles and antiques; 72% of respondents seek to reconnect with hobbies and interests; the survey covers nine markets including Germany.
Used For: Directional evidence for adult collectible; media; display and repair-adjacent organization concepts.

Title: 2025 Year-End Recorded Music Revenue Report
Evidence Used: RIAA reports US vinyl revenue of about $1 billion; up 9.3%; with 19 consecutive years of growth.
Used For: Directional evidence for vinyl and adjacent physical-media organization accessories; US signal only.

Title: Pinterest Predicts 2026
Evidence Used: Pinterest reports directional search growth for pen-pal and mail rituals (cute stamps +105%; pen-pal ideas +90%; snail-mail gifts +110%), Poetcore (poet aesthetic +175%; poet core +75%), and fragrance rituals (niche perfume collection +500%; layering combinations +125%; scent layering +75%; perfume notes +80%).
Used For: Directional platform-search evidence for correspondence, writing-ritual and dry fragrance-accessory organization; not German product-level demand proof.
